title: A resume theme made for print

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Your resume as a data file, and the page just appears. That's the promise of JSON Resume.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: This project is Antoine's fork of the Kendall theme for JSON Resume. It turns structured resume data into a clean HTML page.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What makes this theme stand out?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's minimalist and built to print well, with schema.org markup so the content stays meaningful to machines too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And how does it work inside?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A small renderer prepares the fields for presentation, then hands them to a Mustache template with separate styles for screen and print. The original author is credited.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It's tiny, just JavaScript and CSS, under the MIT license.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A good example of a small, focused tool. See the page for the details.
